validUntilBeforeIssued: The valid-until date can't be before the issue date.
tooManyItems: A quote can have at most 200 items.
taxRateRange: Tax rate must be between 0% and 100%.
discountTooLarge: The discount can't exceed the subtotal (or 100%).
totalTooLarge: The quote total is too large.
tooManyRecipients: You can add up to 5 CC recipients.
messageTooLong: The message can be at most 2,000 characters.
invalidUrl: Enter a website address, e.g. https://example.com.
invalidNumberPattern: The pattern needs exactly one '{SEQ}' or '{SEQ:n}' and may only use '{YYYY}' '{YY}' '{ROC}' '{MM}' '{DD}'.
validityDaysRange: Validity must be between 1 and 365 days.
invalidCurrency: Choose a valid currency code (e.g. TWD, USD).
imageTooLarge: The image must be 1 MB or smaller.
unsupportedImage: Upload a PNG or JPEG image.
imageDimensionsTooLarge: The image is too large. Use at most about 4 megapixels (e.g. 2048 × 2048).
